findings.text: `assert shared_fleet == alone_fleet` compares two identical empty readings and cannot fail: `recovery_stream._historical_reference_rate` calls `ledger.load(project)` with no root (reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py:167), which resolves the config-home ledger under RECKON_HOME, while the fixture seeds its 2,000-row ledger at the checkout root (`ledger.write(..., root=repository)` in tests/test_a_promotion_does_not_read_the_whole_ledger_index.py:_seed_ledger). The function returns (None, 0) on both sides whatever the region does, so the done-when's 'the fleet-state reading ... still return[s] the same values' clause is unmeasured; the landing half of the same test is genuine because `_landing_preconditions` is passed `ledger_root=repository`.

Three helpers fork capabilities the module this file already imports owns: `_drive_promotion` (:138) re-implements `_drive_one_promotion` (tests/test_a_promotion_does_not_read_the_whole_ledger_index.py:207), `_write_role_run` (:67) re-implements `_write_completed_run` (:122), and the `home`/`repository` fixtures (:50, :59) copy :190 and :199 verbatim. The owner was left unparameterised rather than extended, so a change to the promotion fixture's shape must be made in two places or the two copies drift.

The done-when requires both arms 'run on all_debug one arm at a time with at most -n 4', but no gate log records a partition: head-gate.log, baseline-gate.log, head-suite.log and baseline-suite.log each name the in-worktree command with no srun/sbatch, so the arms ran in the fleet allocation the worker was launched under. The arms did run one at a time and are light (31.02 s and 12.03 s), so the measurement stands; the partition clause is unevidenced.

The freshness case's discriminating power rests on a mutant the manifest claims ('a second mutant that lets the region outlive its close fails the freshness case') but no log for it sits under the run directory; only the no-share mutant is recorded, in logs/negative-control-no-share.log. The done-when requires every log under the run directory, so the second mutant is a claim a reader cannot open.
